mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate reached 5.33% in December 2023
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the average 20-day return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.5 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which drives equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, indicating weakening economic momentum and reduced corporate earnings prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% and FEDFUNDS above 5.0% indicate a persistent inflationary environment that justifies continued restrictive monetary policy, suppressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS above 157,000 and a decline in UNRATE below 3.8% signals a strong labor market that fuels consumption and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 157000 and UNRATE < 3.8%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 685,000 million dollars signals strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of all observations, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 101.0 combined with a rise in the unemployment rate above 3.8% signals a weakening economy with both supply-side contraction and labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 101.0 and UNRATE > 3.8%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).
